title.zh: 推出的范围达不到的：它单向地到达自身延续所依存的，随想要的结束而结束；满足此处推出的每项要求的持续形成仍可以终结它不需要的生命；沿依存，中心不由动力学推出
title.en: What the derived extent does not reach: it runs one way, to what one's continuation depends on, and ends with the want; a continuing formation meeting every requirement derived here can still end a life it does not need; along dependence the center is not derived from the dynamics

claim.zh: 顺着想要自身延续，给出求取其延续所需之物的理由；由动力学推出的这一范围有四个界限，各有一个满足平衡与活动需要支持的见证。单向：Downstream 中自身的延续只依存于它的地，每步都活跃且被支持；以它所给为生的下游形成在它停止给予后终结（Downstream.one_way）。不必有来源条件复现：必要的是得到供给，不必有哪个来源条件复现（Lone.fed_not_recurring，见 continuing-self-fed-from-beyond；输送的始终是同一个源，所以这不说明不需要特定的来源形成）。想要的视界：Mortal 中一个生命只有两步的形成，活着时每项依存都被满足，它的取用终结了共享条件的更新，依存于该条件的后继者在它终结之后才终结（Mortal.after_its_end）；没有它时，更新者与后继者每步都延续（Mortal.without_continues）。清除者：Clearing 中清除者每步都活跃且被支持，它只依存于自己的资源，资源被更新、每步从其外得到供给（源从当步的燃料输送入）、被联合地在所给之内取用；流平衡且耗散；它清除栖居者的栖息地，它在第一步的事件侵蚀栖居者，后者从第二步起不活跃（Clearing.undermines_within_renewal）。源什么都不需要，这是规定的；这些见证中的终结由其活动规定，见证表明它们与平衡、支持和依存相容，终结的推出在一般定理中。沿依存，中心不由动力学推出：一个事件的形成的延续被另一个事件供给，是指在同一步上后者的形成参与并向前者所需的条件给予（Flow.FedBy）；只有清除者的延续被供给，且只被源供给（Clearing.fedBy_source）。各形成持有并珍视自身的事件，清除者也珍视源的事件（Clearing.valuation）：每个生命都被持有（Web.held_by_formations，见 held-lives-g0-is-centering），S0 处处成立，各立场的意义沿供给封闭，而栖居者在第零步活的事件从清除者的立场没有意义，N_std 与 G0 不成立；同一评价中，清除者在第零步的事件经栖息地与之相关，从清除者自身区域沿已形成关系的传递不成立（Clearing.center_not_derived）。所以这条界线对沿依存推出的范围成立，对沿每个已形成关系推出的范围不成立。S0 只涉及活的主张：清除者在第一步的事件活跃而不活，S0 对它无所说（Clearing.clearer_not_living）。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。
claim.en: Following a want for one's continuation gives reason to secure what that continuation needs; the extent so derived from the dynamics has four limits, each with a witness meeting balance and activity needing support. One way: in Downstream the self's continuation requires only its ground, and the self is active and supported at every step; a downstream formation living on what the self gives ends once the self stops giving (Downstream.one_way). No source condition need recur: being fed is needed, and no source condition need recur (Lone.fed_not_recurring, see continuing-self-fed-from-beyond; the one source does all the conveying, so this does not show that no particular source formation is needed). The horizon of the want: in Mortal a formation whose life is two steps has every dependence met while it lives, its taking ends the renewal of a shared condition, and a successor depending on that condition ends after it has ended (Mortal.after_its_end); without it the renewer and the successor continue at every step (Mortal.without_continues). The clearer: in Clearing the clearer is active and supported at every step and depends only on its resource, which is renewed, fed from beyond at every step (the source conveys the step's fuel into it) and taken from jointly within what is given; the flow balances and is dissipative; the clearer clears the dweller's habitat, its event at step one undermines the dweller, and the dweller is inactive from step two on (Clearing.undermines_within_renewal). The source requires nothing by stipulation; the endings in these witnesses are stipulated in their activity, the witnesses show them consistent with balance, support and dependence, and the general theorems are where endings are derived. Along dependence the center is not derived from the dynamics: the continuation of an event's formation is fed by another event when, at their common step, the other's formation takes part and gives to a condition the first requires (Flow.FedBy); only the clearer's continuation is fed, and only by the source (Clearing.fedBy_source). With each formation holding and valuing its own events and the clearer valuing also the source's (Clearing.valuation), every life is held (Web.held_by_formations, see held-lives-g0-is-centering), S0 holds everywhere and each standpoint's significance is closed along feeding, while the dweller's living event at step zero has no significance from the clearer, so N_std and G0 fail; in the same valuation the clearer's event at step zero is related to it through the habitat, and transmission out of the clearer's own region along the formed relations fails (Clearing.center_not_derived). So the line holds for an extent derived along dependence and fails for one derived along every formed relation. S0 ranges over living claims: the clearer's event at step one is active and not living, and S0 says nothing of it (Clearing.clearer_not_living). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

hypotheses.zh: 想要的形式：顺着想要给出求取其延续所需之物的理由；从想要一个目的到有理由求其所需的一步是公开的前提，不是定理。
hypotheses.en: The form of the want: following a want gives reason to secure what its continuation needs; the step from wanting an end to having reason for what it requires is a disclosed premise, not a theorem.

hypotheses.zh: “此处推出的要求”指本组结果中的那些：从其外得到供给、联合地在所给之内、所依存者被更新、活动被支持；不是任意可能的要求。中心的见证把推出的范围读作沿依存（FedBy：在同一步向所需条件给予），不是沿每个已形成的关系。
hypotheses.en: ‘Requirements derived here’ means those of this group of results: being fed from beyond, taking jointly within what is given, the conditions depended on being renewed, activity supported; not every conceivable requirement. The center witness reads the derived extent as running along dependence (FedBy: giving to a required condition at a common step), not along every formed relation.

hypotheses.zh: Mortal 的有限生命是给定的：它不说形成为什么终结，只说它终结后它的取用的后果仍在；其余见证的终结同样由其活动规定。
hypotheses.en: Mortal's finite life is supplied: it does not say why the formation ends, only that the consequences of its taking outlast it; the other witnesses' endings are likewise stipulated in their activity.

hypotheses.zh: 源什么都不需要，这是规定的（Clearing、Lone）；主张层面的意义分不开把他者算作条件与算作想要者。
hypotheses.en: The source requires nothing, by stipulation (Clearing, Lone); claim-level significance does not separate counting another as a condition from counting it as a being that wants.

correspondence.zh: Ren 的提议说：“all above does not require any axiom”，又说那条公理“closes the whole”。AI 的分析（Ren 答“exactly”）说：推出的范围单向地到达自身所依存的，以条件而不是以想要的存在者到达他者，而谨慎的总体化者（其见证现名 `Clearing`）满足它的全部；所以动力学定出系统的范围，定不出中心。本结果给出这四个界限的见证。计划把第四个见证当作检验：若推出的要求迫使立场中立，中心就会由动力学推出。独立审查（W8）指出，最初的见证所含的传递合取由 S0 推出，Flow 与 Web 的谓词从不约束意义，所以检验如原样提出不可能失败；“见证造出来了”作为检验通过的说法撤回。现在的见证含沿依存的封闭：清除者的意义沿供给它的事件传递，仍不到达栖居者。沿每个已形成关系读时，同一见证中从清除者自身区域的传递不成立；在依存使每两个生命都相连的整体中，S0 加沿依存的 N_rel 给出 G0（held-lives-g0-is-centering 的 significant_of_transmits）。所以“中心不由推出”的范围是：推出的范围沿依存，并且某个活的主张在某个想要者的依存闭包之外。清除者是元吸引子所选出的自我的一种形式：它不是不计入其外，而是只计入它自己的延续所需的那部分。这不是对它的道德判决（AI 的读法）。
correspondence.en: Ren's proposal says “all above does not require any axiom” and that the one axiom “closes the whole”. The AI analysis, which Ren answered “exactly”, said the derived extent runs one way, to what the self depends on, reaches others as conditions rather than as beings that want, and is all satisfied by a careful totalizer (the witness now named `Clearing`); so the dynamics fixes a system's extent, not its center. This result gives witnesses of these four limits. The plan took the fourth witness as a test: had the derived requirements forced standpoint neutrality, the center would follow from the dynamics. The independent review (W8) found that the first witness's transmission conjunct follows from S0 and that flow and web predicates never constrain significance, so the test as posed could not fail; ‘the witness exists’ as a passed test is withdrawn. The present witness includes closure along dependence: the clearer's significance passes to the events feeding it and still does not reach the dweller. Read along every formed relation, transmission out of the clearer's own region fails in the same witness; in a whole where dependence links every two lives, S0 with N_rel along dependence gives G0 (significant_of_transmits in held-lives-g0-is-centering). So ‘the center is not derived’ holds where the derived extent runs along dependence and some living claim lies outside some wanting formation's dependence closure. The clearer is one form of the self the meta-attractor selects: it does not fail to count what lies beyond it, it counts only what its own continuation needs. This is not a moral verdict on it (an AI reading).

detail.zh: 复用 FedFromBeyond 与 Lone.fed_not_recurring；清除者的资源每步都从其外得到供给（Clearing.fed）。
detail.en: Reuses FedFromBeyond and Lone.fed_not_recurring; the clearer's resource is fed from beyond at every step (Clearing.fed).

output.zh: 从其外得到供给的定义与不必有来源条件复现的见证。
output.en: Being fed from beyond, and the witness that no source condition need recur.

detail.zh: 复用 WithinJoint；清除者对其资源联合地在所给之内。
detail.en: Reuses WithinJoint; the clearer takes from its resource jointly within what is given.

output.zh: 联合地在所给之内的定义。
output.en: Taking jointly within what is given.

detail.zh: 复用 Web.held_by_formations 与 Valuation.Held（并经它复用估值的定义）；中心的见证在其上陈述。
detail.en: Reuses Web.held_by_formations and Valuation.Held (and through it the definitions of valuations); the center witness is stated on them.

output.zh: 逐步读、每个形成以自身事件为自身区域时每个活的事件都被持有；被持有的生命上 G0 恰等于处处 S0 加 N_std。
output.en: Read stepwise with each formation's own events its own region, every living event is held; on held lives G0 is exactly S0 everywhere with N_std.

input.zh: 沿依存推出的范围不迫使 N_std。
input.en: The extent derived along dependence does not force N_std.

conditions.zh: 每个形成以自身事件为自身区域；推出的范围沿依存。
conditions.en: Each formation's own events its own region; the derived extent runs along dependence.

input.zh: 清除者在第一步的事件侵蚀栖居者。
input.en: The clearer's event at step one undermines the dweller.

detail.zh: 清除者的流沿用 Lone 的源与燃料（Frontier）。
detail.en: The clearer's flow follows Lone's source and fuels (Frontier).

detail.zh: 消耗者起初形成更多，每步的计数偏好它；清除者不消耗自己的资源，而消耗他者的栖息地。
detail.en: A consumer forms more at first and a one-step count prefers it; the clearer does not consume its own resource, only another's habitat.

detail.zh: 清除者满足此处推出的每项要求而终结另一个形成（Clearing.undermines_within_renewal）。
detail.en: The clearer meets every requirement derived here and ends another formation (Clearing.undermines_within_renewal).

detail.zh: 单向（Downstream.one_way）与想要的视界（Mortal.after_its_end；没有它时其余延续，Mortal.without_continues）。
detail.en: One way (Downstream.one_way) and the horizon of the want (Mortal.after_its_end; without it the others continue, Mortal.without_continues).

detail.zh: 沿依存，中心不由动力学推出；沿每个已形成关系的传递在同一见证中不成立（Clearing.center_not_derived）。
detail.en: Along dependence the center is not derived from the dynamics; transmission along every formed relation fails in the same witness (Clearing.center_not_derived).

limitations.zh: 见证是最小的；“此处推出的要求”限于本组结果中的那些，更强的要求（例如对他者依存的计入）没有被排除，只是不由想要自身延续推出；中心的界线只对沿依存推出的范围成立，在依存使每两个生命都相连的整体中不成立；源什么都不需要是规定的；见证中的终结由其活动规定，Mortal 的终结是给定的；不评价清除者，也不推出它应当保护他者；伤害读在哪个层次由 Ren 选择；名称（Downstream、Mortal、Clearing、clearer、dweller、successor 等）是 AI 按 Ren 10 月 10 日的命名标准所选（零公理部分用描述抽象动力学的形式词，社会与金融词汇不作首选），读法仍由 Ren 选择。
limitations.en: The witnesses are minimal; ‘requirements derived here’ are those of this group of results, and stronger requirements (such as counting others' dependence) are not excluded, only not derived from wanting one's own continuation; the line on the center holds only for an extent derived along dependence, and not in a whole where dependence links every two lives; that the source requires nothing is stipulated; the witnesses' endings are stipulated in their activity, and Mortal's ending is supplied; evaluates no clearer and does not infer that it ought to protect others; at which level harm is read is Ren's choice; the names (Downstream, Mortal, Clearing, clearer, dweller, successor and others) are the AI's choice under Ren's naming criteria of 10 October (in the zero-axiom part, formal words describing the abstract dynamics, social and financial words not the first choice), and readings remain Ren's.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器成功实查（20261011T071749.484228Z）：Becoming.Continuation 的 40 项定理，Becoming.Standpoints 的 22 项定理全部空依赖；同一回执覆盖包内 41 个模块（含只作导入的根模块与桥接），共 2171 项定理／3257 项声明审计，15 个继承模块的当前字节与已通过回执一致；外围回执 20261011T071753.574921Z 通过。作者反审见整合文档 §47；独立审查（CONTINUATION-GROUNDING-REVIEW.md）接受其 Lean，所提更正在整合文档 §47.1–47.4 处理。检查器另核对核心纯净：核心（GenerativeCore、InquirySufficiency、RelationalRenewal、L1–L4 与根模块 Becoming）的导入闭包恰为这 43 个模块，其中每条源声明的公理报告为空（Lean 生成的常量中，只有带字段构造子的单射引理 injEq 依赖 propext，没有源声明使用它们，检查器逐一列出），并且只用 Lean 内置前导即可编译（基础模块的 import Std 在该次编译中去掉）。
validation_scope.en: Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261011T071749.484228Z): the 40 theorems of Becoming.Continuation, the 22 theorems of Becoming.Standpoints all have empty axiom reports; the same receipt covers the package's 41 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 2171 theorems/3257 declaration audits, and 15 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261011T071753.574921Z passed. The author's counterreview is in §47 of the integration note; the independent review (CONTINUATION-GROUNDING-REVIEW.md) accepts its Lean, and its corrections are handled in §47.1–47.4 of the integration note. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 43 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run).

next_delta.zh: 伤害的层级（个体、谱系、整体）在见证上的形式；跨世代的想要（谱系的延续）是否越过想要的视界；终结他者服务于清除者延续的见证（元吸引子的更强情形）；强制形式的终结（对 active 量化）；两个可移除来源交替供给的见证；整段读法上的同一界限。
next_delta.en: The level of harm (member, lineage, whole) on the witnesses; whether a want across generations (a lineage's continuation) passes the horizon of the want; a witness in which ending another serves the clearer's continuation (a stronger case of the meta-attractor); forced endings (quantifying over active); a witness fed alternately by two removable sources; the same limits on the whole-run reading.

C1, C3, C7, C10, C11, C13: Totalizer.valuation now has the keeper value also the sun's events, and Totalizer.center_not_derived now includes closure along feeding, the keeper's event related to the other's, and transmission out of the own region along formed relations failing (the earlier statement, held lives, S0 everywhere, transmission into each own region, the other living and not valued by the keeper, N_std and G0 failing, was checked in receipt 20261009T222752.438253Z; its transmission conjunct follows from S0); Flow.FedBy, Totalizer.sig, Totalizer.fedBy_sun and Totalizer.keeper_not_living are added; ‘the witness exists’ as a passed test is withdrawn and the line is scoped to dependence; the second limit becomes ‘no source condition need recur’; the stipulated endings and sun are disclosed; the Chinese limitations are aligned with the English; the declaration belongs to this record alone.
